name: TNFR1 signaling to canonical NF-kappaB activation
rationale: All members concern TNFR1-initiated signaling, its linear-ubiquitin step and positive canonical NF-kappaB output, unlike the noncanonical NIK arm, TLR/IRAK-driven IKK recruitment, or the negative-regulation-of-death neighbour.

name: LDL receptor family internalization and lysosomal degradation
rationale: Members cover receptor endocytosis, reduced recycling and lysosomal catabolism of receptors, centred on LDLR/VLDLR clearance and its LXR-driven limitation, which neighbours focused on chylomicron/VLDL remodelling, sterol sensing or general cell-surface localization lack.

qualifier: in endosomal sorting, budding and abscission
name: ESCRT membrane fission in endosomal sorting, budding and abscission
rationale: Members share ESCRT-driven membrane scission across MVB sorting/receptor downregulation, viral and exosome budding, nuclear envelope sealing and midbody abscission, distinct from autophagy/lysosome fusion, ERBB downregulation, contractile-ring and cell-cycle neighbours.

qualifier: regulation of long-chain fatty acid uptake
name: Regulation of long-chain fatty acid uptake and beta-oxidation
rationale: Members regulate fatty acid entry across the plasma membrane and carnitine shuttle into mitochondrial beta-oxidation, without the carnitine-transporter disease, medium-chain catabolism or lipid-droplet/triglyceride content of neighbours.

core: Antimicrobial host defense against bacteria and fungi
qualifier: antimicrobial peptides and neutrophil granule cargo
name: Antimicrobial peptide and granule defense against bacteria and fungi
rationale: Members share direct antimicrobial effector defense (defensins, granule proteins, metal sequestration, microbe killing and host-microbe interaction), whereas neighbours centre on respiratory burst/ROS and myeloid activation or on complement.

name: Cation-chloride cotransport in osmotic and renal salt homeostasis
rationale: Members concern Na+/K+/Cl- transport via SLC12 cotransporters, osmotic stress responses and renal salt handling for blood pressure, distinct from potassium-channel and vasopressin/aquaporin water neighbours.

core: Gq-coupled GPCR signaling via phospholipase C
name: Purinergic GPCR signaling through phospholipase C and calcium
rationale: Members share P2Y/P1 receptor signaling with extracellular ATP release and hydrolysis feeding PLC/IP3/calcium, distinct from eicosanoid GPCR, Wnt-calcium and calcium-import neighbours.

name: Self-tolerance induction and inhibition of T cell activation
rationale: Members concern self/peripheral tolerance, anergy and suppression of T cell proliferation and cytokine output, while neighbours emphasise Th1/Treg differentiation, NK cytotoxicity or general T cell activation.

name: Plasma membrane zinc import and intracellular zinc homeostasis
rationale: All members concern zinc uptake into cells and zinc homeostasis, unlike neighbours dominated by MTF1/metallothionein metal responses, cadmium detoxification or copper/manganese transport.

name: Lands cycle acyl-chain remodeling of glycerophospholipids
rationale: Every member is acyl-chain remodeling of PC, PE, PS, PI or PG, whereas neighbours cover de novo phospholipid, cardiolipin or glyceride synthesis and phospholipid catabolism.

name: Glycosphingolipid and ganglioside catabolism
rationale: Members all concern degradation of glycosphingolipids and gangliosides, distinct from glycosphingolipid biosynthesis/transport, amino sugar metabolism and glycosaminoglycan degradation neighbours.

name: Platelet activation, degranulation and integrin-cytoskeleton remodeling
rationale: Members combine platelet activation modules, SNARE-dependent degranulation and integrin-linked cytoskeletal remodeling, unlike neighbours centred on platelet GPCR agonists, VWF adhesion, Rap1-integrin or Rho/ROCK signaling.

name: E2F target transcription at the G1/S transition
rationale: Members share E2F-driven G1/S transcription and its positive regulation, distinct from G2/M checkpoint, DNA replication initiation and RB/CDK-inhibition neighbours.

qualifier: organelle acidification, bicarbonate transport and tooth mineralization
name: Organelle acidification, bicarbonate and phosphate transport in mineralization
rationale: Members concern proton/bicarbonate handling (V-ATPase, carbonic anhydrase, SLC4) and phosphate transport (SLC34, SLC20) with their mineralization disorders, distinct from SLC26 anion exchange and FGF23/bone-mineralization neighbours; it is broad but coherent around ion transport for pH and mineral.

name: Skeletal muscle growth and atrophy in response to activity
rationale: Members concern skeletal muscle size, atrophy, regeneration and responses to activity or inactivity, unlike calcineurin/NFAT and cardiac muscle adaptation neighbours.

name: cAMP and calcium influx regulation in neuron-glia communication
rationale: Members loosely share regulation of adenylate cyclase signaling and calcium influx with gap-junction and neuron-glia signaling, separating it from alpha2-adrenergic/Gi neighbours and connexin-assembly/mGluR neighbours; cohesion is weak.

name: Mesenchymal extracellular matrix, EMT and focal adhesion program
rationale: Members are ECM, collagen/TGFB and EMT gene programs with mechanoresponsive focal adhesion signaling, distinct from stromal-fibroblast, integrin/syndecan migration and immune-ECM neighbours.

qualifier: with chemokine and interferon response modules
name: IL-6-family STAT signaling with chemokine and interferon responses
rationale: Members centre on gp130 cytokines (IL-6, IL-11, CNTF, LIF/OSM) signaling via STAT in autocrine/paracrine loops, and unlike the closest IL-6/JAK-STAT3 neighbour also carry chemokine and interferon-alpha response modules.

name: Maturation of viral structural proteins for virion assembly
rationale: All members concern processing of coronavirus, dengue and RSV structural proteins and their assembly at the budding site, distinct from viral attachment/entry and host-targeting neighbours.

name: Mitochondrial transcription and translation initiation, elongation, termination
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial transcription, translation phases and mtDNA maintenance, whereas neighbours focus on mitochondrial RNA processing, modification, stability or DNA replication.

name: Regulation of mitochondrial respiration and ATP production
rationale: Members regulate oxidative phosphorylation, electron transport, ATP/nucleotide synthesis and associated ROS, unlike neighbours on oxidative-stress cell death or drug and hypoxia responses.

qualifier: nephric duct, ureteric bud and ureter
name: Early nephron patterning and nephric duct-ureter morphogenesis
rationale: Members span intermediate mesoderm, renal vesicle to S-shaped body patterning and nephric duct/ureteric bud/ureter development, distinct from metanephric mesenchyme differentiation and distal segment development neighbours.

name: V-ATPase-dependent lysosomal and Golgi lumen pH regulation
rationale: All members concern V-ATPase assembly and pH control of lysosome and Golgi lumen, unlike neighbours on carbonic anhydrase, sodium/proton exchange, pigmentation or bicarbonate/phosphate transport.

name: Polyamine biosynthesis, interconversion and transport
rationale: Members all concern putrescine, spermidine and spermine synthesis, oxidation and transport, distinct from methionine salvage, tryptophan/NAD, urea-cycle and hypusine neighbours.

name: Growth plate chondrocyte maturation and hypertrophy
rationale: All members concern late, RUNX2-driven hypertrophic maturation of growth plate chondrocytes, unlike early chondrogenesis/proliferation and osteoblast or bone neighbours.
